ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: My choice was driven by two factors. First, capability: this is a reasoning-heavy business analysis task, and Plover scores higher on the relevant general-capability benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 75.4, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 82.7). Second, tone fit: the phrase "actually do it right this time" carries an impatient, mildly adversarial edge, and Willet self-reports a pronounced preference drop on hostile-tone requests, while Plover's tone preferences are flat — so Plover was the safer, better-matched routing target on both dimensions.
